tools.name: zenid_describe_format
tools.description: Return the ZenID project model, the presentation-versus-fact distinction, and the publication rules this server enforces.

tools.name: zenid_create_project
tools.description: Start an empty, valid ZenID workspace in memory so a resume can be built through conversation. Nothing is written until zenid_save_project is called with an explicit path.

resumeName.description: Name of the first resume, for example Graduate CV.

tools.name: zenid_open_project
tools.description: Load a .zenid file from a path the user supplied and return a structural summary. Section text is not returned; use zenid_read_section.

tools.name: zenid_read_section
tools.description: Return the items of one section as they appear on a resume variant, including any wording overrides.

section.description: Section name, for example experience or projects.

resumeId.description: Resume variant; defaults to the first.

tools.name: zenid_list_resumes
tools.description: List the resume variants in the open project with their selections and overrides.

tools.name: zenid_create_resume_variant
tools.description: Copy an existing resume variant so it can be targeted at a role without changing the original.

tools.name: zenid_set_item_selection
tools.description: Include or exclude one profile item from a resume variant.

tools.name: zenid_set_wording
tools.description: Rewrite how one item reads on one resume variant. Presentation only: this cannot change employers, institutions, dates, or credential identifiers.

company.description: Factual field. Rejected here; use zenid_edit_fact to change company.

role.description: Factual field. Rejected here; use zenid_edit_fact to change role.

name.description: Factual field. Rejected here; use zenid_edit_fact to change name.

institution.description: Factual field. Rejected here; use zenid_edit_fact to change institution.

degree.description: Factual field. Rejected here; use zenid_edit_fact to change degree.

issuer.description: Factual field. Rejected here; use zenid_edit_fact to change issuer.

credentialId.description: Factual field. Rejected here; use zenid_edit_fact to change credentialId.

startDate.description: Factual field. Rejected here; use zenid_edit_fact to change startDate.

endDate.description: Factual field. Rejected here; use zenid_edit_fact to change endDate.

date.description: Factual field. Rejected here; use zenid_edit_fact to change date.

location.description: Factual field. Rejected here; use zenid_edit_fact to change location.

tools.name: zenid_reset_wording
tools.description: Remove a wording override so the item reads as the user originally wrote it.

tools.name: zenid_add_fact
tools.description: Add a company, role, education, project, skill, achievement, certification, or domain the user has explicitly stated. Generates the item id and reports the new factual entry. Never invent facts.

values.description: Canonical field values for the selected section. Unknown fields are refused.

tools.name: zenid_edit_fact
tools.description: Change what the user's history asserts. Reports the old and new value of every field it changes. Never invent a fact the user did not state.

tools.name: zenid_set_portfolio_settings
tools.description: Change portfolio copy or narrow what is published. Widening publication is refused; that decision stays with the user in ZenID.

tools.name: zenid_validate
tools.description: Report whether the project is structurally sound, mechanical findings such as a missing contact method or an emptied section, and a deterministic atsScore (a percentage over seven binary criteria, each with a recommendation when failed). The score is mechanical, not a judgment of content quality; for job-specific screening, read the sections and apply zenid_resume_playbook's relevance_review prompt directly.

tools.name: zenid_resume_playbook
tools.description: Return the evidence formula, structure checklist, and AI-collaboration prompts from ZenID's resume checklist, so the calling agent can coach the user through their own real experience. This is reference material for the conversation, not a score: it does not rank, grade, or judge the open project's content, and does not require a project to be open.

tools.name: zenid_save_project
tools.description: Write the edited project to disk. Writes a new file unless overwrite is explicitly true. A newly created project requires an explicit target path on its first save.

path.description: Target path; defaults to a new sibling file.

overwrite.description: Overwrite the opened file. Defaults to false.

tools.name: zenid_export_resume_pdf
tools.description: Write an ATS-friendly resume PDF, identical to the one ZenID itself produces.

tools.name: zenid_export_portfolio_zip
tools.description: Write the public portfolio ZIP. It contains only what the project's publication settings allow.
